name: claude-ops
description: Idle auto-compaction for durable-state runs: compacts an idle conductor with work in flight, plus a cancellable failsafe for any idle session at 75%.

autocompact.title: Autocompact
autocompact.description: Idle auto-compaction, for every project (user settings): on = an idle conductor (any session running a durable-state run, whatever skill drives it) over 25% plus a cancellable failsafe for any idle session at 75%; conductor-only = the conductor rule alone; off = never. /claude-autocompact on|off overrides it for one session.
